# KTX2 fixtures

Generated by `node scripts/ktx2-fixtures.mjs` with ktx version: v4.4.2; do not edit by hand. The PNGs are drawn by the
script, 64 x 64. `planes-<variant>.glb` puts them on two planes: `lit` (colour, normal and the packed
occlusion/roughness/metallic map) and `blended` (the alpha ramp).
